string.ID: Your new pet is ready to love.

strings.string: 你的新宠物已经准备好爱你了。

string.Value: [=turns.things:turn=]

string.ID: You should view the tooltip before equipping the axe.

strings.string: 装备斧头之前，你应该先查看工具提示。

string.ID: Huh, you somehow destroyed the battle axe. Let's move on.

strings.string: 咦，你不知怎么把战斧毁掉了。继续吧。

string.ID: The battle axe has better penetration and deals more damage than your dagger.

strings.string: 战斧比你的匕首有更高的穿透力，也能造成更多伤害。

string.ID:
Let's take another look at weapon stats. Next to the {{c|→}} is 5. That means you'll usually penetrate the armor of a creature with AV equal to 5.
You can penetrate armor multiple times, though, and each time you penetrate, you deal the weapon's damage.
Let's equip it.
string.Value:
再看看武器属性。{{c|→}} 旁边是 5，意思是你通常能穿透 AV 等于 5 的生物护甲。
不过，你可以多次穿透护甲，每次穿透都会造成一次武器伤害。
把它装备上吧。

string.ID:
A battle axe. Get it.
Hit =commandKey:CmdUse=
string.Value:
一把战斧。拿起来。
按 =commandKey:CmdUse=

string.ID:
A battle axe. Get it.
Hit =commandKey:CmdGet=
string.Value:
一把战斧。拿起来。
按 =commandKey:CmdGet=

string.ID: Looks like there was some sort of battle to the north. Let's grab the gear that was left behind.

strings.string: 北边好像发生过某种战斗。去把留下的装备拿上吧。

string.ID:
Let's take a look at the Equipment screen.
Press =commandKey:CmdCharacter=
string.Value:
来看看装备界面。
按 =commandKey:CmdCharacter=

string.ID:
Let's take a look at the Equipment screen.
Press =commandKey:CmdEquipment=
string.Value:
来看看装备界面。
按 =commandKey:CmdEquipment=

string.ID: Hold on, we want to show you the tooltip compare feature.

strings.string: 等等，我们想先给你演示工具提示比较功能。

string.ID: Press =commandKey:GamepadAlt= + =commandKey:Take A Step= to view the tooltip.

strings.string: 按 =commandKey:GamepadAlt= + =commandKey:Take A Step= 查看工具提示。

string.ID: Mouse over the battle axe and hover or press {{W|Alt}} to view the tooltip.

strings.string: 把鼠标移到战斧上悬停，或按 {{W|Alt}} 查看工具提示。

string.ID: Equip the battle axe since it's better than your dagger.

strings.string: 装备战斧，它比你的匕首更好。

string.ID:
Select the Inventory && Equipment tab.
You can use =commandKey:Page Left= and =commandKey:Page Right= to navigate between tabs.
string.Value:
选择物品栏 && 装备标签页。
你可以用 =commandKey:Page Left= 和 =commandKey:Page Right= 在标签页之间切换。

string.ID:
The bear is dead! Looks like it dropped something, too.
But first, let's use this opportunity to heal.
string.Value:
熊死了！看起来还掉了东西。
不过先趁这个机会治疗一下。

string.ID:
You regain hitpoints naturally as turns pass. You can pass a few turns by waiting, or if there are no hostile creatures around, you can {{W|rest until healed}}.
Press =commandKey:CmdWaitUntilHealed=
string.Value:
随着回合流逝，你会自然恢复生命值。你可以通过等待来跳过几个回合；如果附近没有敌对生物，也可以{{W|休息直到痊愈}}。
按 =commandKey:CmdWaitUntilHealed=

string.ID: It's a chem cell. It can be used later to power other artifacts you find.

strings.string: 这是化学电池。之后可以用它给你找到的其他造物供能。

string.ID:
You picked up the odd trinket automatically because it is an artifact.
Press =commandKey:CmdCharacter= to investigate it.
string.Value:
你自动捡起了那个古怪小玩意，因为它是一件造物。
按 =commandKey:CmdCharacter= 调查它。

string.ID:
You picked up the odd trinket automatically because it is an artifact.
Press =commandKey:CmdInventory= to investigate it.
string.Value:
你自动捡起了那个古怪小玩意，因为它是一件造物。
按 =commandKey:CmdInventory= 调查它。

string.ID: The bear is dead! Looks like it dropped something, too.

strings.string: 熊死了！看起来还掉了东西。

string.ID: This is an artifact beyond simple understanding. Try examining it.

strings.string: 这是一件无法凭常识理解的造物。试着检查它。

string.ID:
Select the Inventory && Equipment tab.
You can use =commandKey:Page Left= and =commandKey:Page Right= to navigate between tabs.
string.Value:
选择物品栏 && 装备标签页。
你可以用 =commandKey:Page Left= 和 =commandKey:Page Right= 在标签页之间切换。

string.ID: The whole game world is a series of contiguous maps. Our passage continues off screen. Let's follow it. Walk north.

strings.string: 整个游戏世界由一系列相连的地图组成。我们的通道延伸到了屏幕外。跟着走吧，向北走。

string.ID:
Oh! it looks like Warden Yrame killed Mehmet. Why, you ask?
Well, named creatures who you can perform the water ritual with, like Mehmet, generate with dynamic faction relationships. In your game, Mehmet must have been hated by the Fellowship of Wardens for some reason.
string.Value:
哦！看起来守望者 Yrame 杀死了 Mehmet。你问为什么？
嗯，像 Mehmet 这样可以和你举行饮水仪式的具名生物，会带着动态派系关系生成。在你的游戏里，Mehmet 一定因为某种原因被守望者兄弟会憎恨了。

string.ID:
And so Warden Yrame took her revenge. In Qud, sometimes even our best efforts at providing a safe starter village are foiled by the simulation!
What a charmed run! It's quite rare for this to happen, but now you get to see this hidden section of the tutorial. Good job.
string.Value:
于是守望者 Yrame 完成了复仇。在卡德，有时即使我们尽力提供一个安全的新手村，也会被模拟系统搅乱！
真是受祝福的一局！这种情况相当罕见，但现在你能看到教程的隐藏片段了。干得好。

string.ID:
You have a few options now. You can roll with it and continue in this world where Mehmet's been revenge-slain. The early game will be a bit harder, but the main quest is not impacted.
You can start over and play the tutorial again, for the "normal" ending, which you were about to reach.
Or, since you were near the end anyway, you can start a new game and begin your journey proper!
string.Value:
现在你有几个选择。你可以顺着这个结果继续，在 Mehmet 被复仇杀死的世界里玩下去。前期会稍微难一点，但主线任务不会受影响。
你也可以重来一次教程，走向你本来快要抵达的那个“正常”结局。
或者，反正你已经接近结尾，也可以直接开始新游戏，正式踏上旅程！

string.ID:
Whatever you choose, good luck, and feel free to return here for a refresher.
Live and drink.
string.Value:
无论你怎么选，祝你好运；需要复习时，随时可以回到这里。
生而饮水。

string.ID:
Quetzal! That's all for the tutorial, friend.
We just scratched the very tip of the surface. Quests, secrets, leveling up, physics, reputation, limbs... we leave that for you to discover.
string.Value:
Quetzal！教程到这里就结束了，朋友。
我们只是轻轻碰了碰表面。任务、秘密、升级、物理、声望、肢体……这些就留给你自己去发现。

string.ID: You're ready to continue the journey on your own, but don't hesitate to play the tutorial again if you need a refresher.

strings.string: 你已经准备好独自继续旅程了；如果需要复习，也别犹豫，再玩一次教程就好。

string.ID: Joppa is a village. Everything you learned in the cave applies here too. Villages are like caves with very high roofs.

strings.string: 约帕是一座村庄。你在洞穴里学到的一切，在这里也同样适用。村庄就像屋顶很高的洞穴。

string.ID:
You can see a list of points of interest by pressing =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest=.
The list will grow as you explore more of the map.
string.Value:
按 =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest= 可以查看兴趣点列表。
随着你探索更多地图，列表也会变长。

string.ID:
You can see a list of points of interest by clicking this button or pressing =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest=.
The list will grow as you explore more of the map.
string.Value:
点击这个按钮或按 =commandKey:CmdMoveToPointOfInterest= 可以查看兴趣点列表。
随着你探索更多地图，列表也会变长。

上楼。
按 =commandKey:CmdMoveU=。

string.ID:
Ascend.
You can click this button or press =commandKey:CmdMoveU=.
string.Value:
上楼。
你可以点击这个按钮，或按 =commandKey:CmdMoveU=。

string.ID: Finally, a staircase. Walk over to it.

You'll be able to explore the world freely after the tutorial.
For now, let's visit Joppa.
string.Value:
教程结束后，你就能自由探索世界。
现在，先去约帕吧。

string.ID:
You can look around here just like on a local map.
Use =commandKey:LookDirection=
string.Value:
你可以像在局部地图上一样环顾这里。
使用 =commandKey:LookDirection=

string.ID:
You can look around here just like on a local map.
Press =commandKey:CmdLook=
string.Value:
你可以像在局部地图上一样环顾这里。
按 =commandKey:CmdLook=

下楼。
按 =commandKey:CmdMoveD=。

string.ID:
Descend.
You can click this button or press =commandKey:CmdMoveD=.
string.Value:
下楼。
你可以点击这个按钮，或按 =commandKey:CmdMoveD=。

string.ID:
There's a village to the north called Joppa. Let's go there.
Hold =commandKey:IndicateDirection= towards the north and press =commandKey:Take A Step=.
string.Value:
北边有座叫约帕的村庄。去那里吧。
按住 =commandKey:IndicateDirection= 指向北方，再按 =commandKey:Take A Step=。

string.ID:
There's a village to the north called Joppa. Let's go there.
Press =commandKey:CmdMoveN= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=.
string.Value:
北边有座叫约帕的村庄。去那里吧。
按 =commandKey:CmdMoveN= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=。

string.ID: Wait for the bear to take a step towards you.
Make sure the bear is in the path of your freezing ray.

strings.string: 确保熊在你的冻结射线路径上。

string.ID: What's that??? Some sort of creature. Take a closer look at it.

strings.string: 那是什么？？？某种生物。仔细看看。

string.ID: It's quite dangerous to fight this bear in melee combat! Try backing away and using Freezing Ray.

strings.string: 和这头熊近战很危险！试着后退并使用冻结射线。

string.ID: Let's take a look at the bear before we continue.

strings.string: 继续之前，先看看这头熊。

string.ID:
Oh! Another creature. Let's look at it more closely.
When you come across something new, it's always a good idea to inspect it.
string.Value:
哦！又有一个生物。仔细看看它。
遇到新东西时，检查一下总是好主意。

string.ID: The bear is wounded, but it's tough. This'll be a harder fight.

strings.string: 这头熊受伤了，但它很强韧。这会是一场更艰难的战斗。

string.ID: Use =commandKey:LookDirection= to look at the bear.

Look view lets you look around and investigate your surroundings.
Move the cursor to the bear.
string.Value:
查看视图让你环顾四周并调查周围环境。
把光标移到熊身上。

string.ID:
You can wait a turn for the bear to approach. That way, it won't be in range to attack you when it takes its turn.
Tap =commandKey:Take A Step= without choosing a direction with the stick to pass a turn.
string.Value:
你可以等待一回合，让熊靠近。这样轮到它行动时，它还够不到你。
不推动摇杆选择方向，轻按 =commandKey:Take A Step= 即可跳过一回合。

string.ID:
You can wait a turn for the bear to approach. That way, it won't be in range to attack you when it takes its turn.
Press =commandKey:CmdWait:allbinds= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction= on your character to pass a turn.
string.Value:
你可以等待一回合，让熊靠近。这样轮到它行动时，它还够不到你。
按 =commandKey:CmdWait:allbinds=，或对你的角色使用 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction= 来跳过一回合。

string.ID:
You missed, then the bear attacked and missed.
Attack again.
string.Value:
你没打中，然后熊攻击你也没打中。
再攻击一次。

string.ID:
This time you hit, but you failed to penetrate the bear's armor.
Then, the bear hit you and DID penetrate your armor. You took 4 damage.
string.Value:
这次你打中了，但没能穿透熊的护甲。
然后，熊击中了你，而且确实穿透了你的护甲。你受到了 4 点伤害。

string.ID:
Let's try using an ability. Look at your ability bar. Let's start sprinting.
Select it with =commandKey:Next Ability= and =commandKey:Previous Ability= then press =commandKey:Use Ability=.
string.Value:
试试使用能力。看看你的能力栏。先开始疾跑。
用 =commandKey:Next Ability= 和 =commandKey:Previous Ability= 选中它，然后按 =commandKey:Use Ability=。

string.ID: Let's try using an ability. Look at your ability bar. Let's start sprinting. You can click the button or hit the hotkey =commandKey:CmdAbility1=.

strings.string: 试试使用能力。看看你的能力栏。先开始疾跑。你可以点击按钮，或按热键 =commandKey:CmdAbility1=。

string.ID: Sprinting doubles your movespeed but ends if you make an attack. Let's sprint back down the corridor to put some distance between us and the bear.

strings.string: 疾跑会让你的移动速度翻倍，但一旦你发动攻击就会结束。沿走廊疾跑回去，和熊拉开距离。

string.ID:
Every character has Sprint, but most of your abilities are determined by traits like your mutations. You have Freezing Ray, so you can shoot frost out of your hands.
Select it with =commandKey:Next Ability= and =commandKey:Previous Ability= then press =commandKey:Use Ability=.
string.Value:
每个角色都有疾跑，但大多数能力由你的突变等特质决定。你拥有冻结射线，所以可以从手中射出寒霜。
用 =commandKey:Next Ability= 和 =commandKey:Previous Ability= 选中它，然后按 =commandKey:Use Ability=。

string.ID:
Every character has Sprint, but most of your abilities are determined by traits like your mutations. You have Freezing Ray, so you can shoot frost out of your hands. Select it.
Press =commandKey:CmdAbility2=
string.Value:
每个角色都有疾跑，但大多数能力由你的突变等特质决定。你拥有冻结射线，所以可以从手中射出寒霜。选中它。
按 =commandKey:CmdAbility2=

string.ID: What's that??? Some sort of creature. Take a closer look at it.

strings.string: 那是什么？？？某种生物。仔细看看。

string.ID: Before you move on, you should loot the corpse of the snapjaw.

strings.string: 继续之前，你应该搜刮裂颚者的尸体。

string.ID: Take a look at the snapjaw before we continue.

strings.string: 继续之前，先看看裂颚者。

string.ID: Huh, you somehow destroyed the leather armor. Let's move on.

strings.string: 咦，你不知怎么把皮甲毁掉了。继续吧。

string.ID: Let's explore further into the cave.

Let's explore further into the cave.
Walk down the passage.
string.Value:
继续深入洞穴探索吧。
沿通道走下去。

string.ID: Looking at a creature shows its description and some other important details. Every object in the world can be looked at.

strings.string: 查看生物会显示它的描述和其他重要细节。世界里的每个物体都可以查看。

string.ID: The snapjaw is hostile! Let's get ready for a fight.

strings.string: 裂颚者有敌意！准备战斗。

string.ID: Use =commandKey:LookDirection= to look at the snapjaw.
Here we have a description of the creature, along with some details about them.

strings.string: 这里会显示这个生物的描述，以及一些相关细节。

string.ID: The snapjaw is hostile! Let's get ready for a fight.

strings.string: 裂颚者有敌意！准备战斗。

string.ID:
Look view lets you look around and investigate your surroundings.
Move the cursor to the snapjaw.
string.Value:
查看视图让你环顾四周并调查周围环境。
把光标移到裂颚者身上。

string.ID:
All actions are turn-based, meaning you take a turn, then other creatures take a turn. For the most part, creatures won't act until you do.
If you ever get panicked, just slow down and consider your next move. There's no rush.
string.Value:
所有行动都是回合制的，意思是你行动一回合，然后其他生物行动一回合。大多数情况下，你不行动，生物也不会行动。
如果你感到慌张，就慢下来，想想下一步。别急。

string.ID: You can attack a hostile creature by moving into its square. This is called {{W|bump attacking}}.

strings.string: 你可以通过移动到敌对生物所在格子来攻击它。这叫做{{W|撞击攻击}}。

string.ID: Take a step toward the snapjaw.

You can pick up things that are in the same space as you.
Press =commandKey:CmdUse=
string.Value:
你可以拾取与你同格的东西。
按 =commandKey:CmdUse=

string.ID:
You can pick up things that are in the same space as you.
Press =commandKey:CmdGet=
string.Value:
你可以拾取与你同格的东西。
按 =commandKey:CmdGet=

string.ID:
Whew! You killed the snapjaw and earned some experience. It looks like they dropped a piece of equipment, too.
Press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction.
string.Value:
呼！你杀死了裂颚者，获得了一些经验。看起来它还掉了一件装备。
按 =commandKey:CmdGetFrom=，然后选择一个方向。

string.ID:
Whew! You killed the snapjaw and earned some experience. It looks like they dropped a piece of equipment, too.
Press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction or press =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract=.
string.Value:
呼！你杀死了裂颚者，获得了一些经验。看起来它还掉了一件装备。
按 =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= 后选择一个方向，或按 =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteract=。

string.ID:
Let's look at the leather armor you picked up.
Armor has an armor value (=av:2=) and a dodge value (=dv:0=)
Both help you avoid damage.
string.Value:
看看你捡到的皮甲。
护甲有护甲值（=av:2=）和闪避值（=dv:0=）。
两者都能帮你避免伤害。

string.ID: It's leather armor. This time, get it instead of equipping it.

strings.string: 这是皮甲。这次先拾取它，而不是直接装备。

string.ID:
Let's take a look at the Equipment screen.
Press =commandKey:CmdCharacter=
string.Value:
来看看装备界面。
按 =commandKey:CmdCharacter=

string.ID:
Let's take a look at the Equipment screen.
Press =commandKey:CmdEquipment=
string.Value:
来看看装备界面。
按 =commandKey:CmdEquipment=

string.ID: This is your equipment and inventory screen. Equipped items on the left, and inventory on the right.

strings.string: 这是你的装备和物品栏界面。已装备物品在左侧，物品栏在右侧。

string.ID:
You can also equip items by dragging them from your inventory to their equipment slot.
By the way, you have several other tabs in your character sheet. Feel free to explore them later.
string.Value:
你也可以把物品从物品栏拖到装备槽来装备。
顺便说一句，你的角色表里还有其他几个标签页。之后可以随便看看。

string.ID:
Select the Inventory && Equipment tab.
You can use =commandKey:Page Left= and =commandKey:Page Right= to navigate between tabs.
string.Value:
选择物品栏 && 装备标签页。
你可以用 =commandKey:Page Left= 和 =commandKey:Page Right= 在标签页之间切换。

string.ID:
Sometimes squares have multiple items in them.
To see everything in a space, press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction.
string.Value:
有时一个格子里会有多个物品。
要查看一个位置里的所有东西，按 =commandKey:CmdGetFrom=，然后选择一个方向。

string.ID:
Sometimes squares have multiple items in them.
To see everything in a space, press =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= and then choose a direction or press =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteractAll=.
string.Value:
有时一个格子里会有多个物品。
要查看一个位置里的所有东西，按 =commandKey:CmdGetFrom= 后选择一个方向，或按 =commandKey:AdventureMouseInteractAll=。

string.ID:
Whoever this was, they had some books. All books can be read in game.
Books with {{Y|white}} titles are generated and usually contain nonsense, but the nonsense can occasionally be useful.
Books with {{W|gold}} titles are more valuable: they are handwritten by in-world beings and contain interesting takes on the world.
string.Value:
不管这人生前是谁，他们带着几本书。游戏里的所有书都可以阅读。
标题为{{Y|白色}}的书是生成文本，通常满是胡言乱语，但这些胡言乱语偶尔也会有用。
标题为{{W|金色}}的书更有价值：它们由世界中的存在亲手写成，包含对这个世界的有趣见解。

string.ID: This water is valuable too. Take it all.

strings.string: 这些水也很值钱。全拿上。

string.ID:
Welcome to the Caves of Qud tutorial. We'll just be scratching the surface here, learning enough of the basics to help you get your footing.
In Caves of Qud, you play as a mutated human or true kin.
For the tutorial, we're picking mutated human.
string.Value:
欢迎来到《卡德洞窟》教程。这里我们只会浅尝辄止，学习足够帮你站稳脚跟的基础。
在《卡德洞窟》中，你扮演变异人或真裔。
教程中，我们会选择变异人。

string.ID:
Character creation is a deep and sometimes long process. We included some preset builds to help you get started. After the tutorial, you can try another build, or make a character from scratch. (The recommended way! Once you get your footing.)
For now, pick the marsh taur.
string.Value:
角色创建很有深度，有时也会花很久。我们准备了一些预设构筑，帮你开始上手。教程结束后，你可以尝试其他构筑，或从零开始制作角色。（等你站稳脚跟后，这才是推荐方式！）
现在，选择沼泽陶尔。

string.ID: Here is a summary of your attributes and mutations, which grant your character unique abilities.

strings.string: 这里汇总了你的属性和突变，它们会赋予角色独特能力。

string.ID: You can name your character or choose Next for a random name.

strings.string: 你可以给角色命名，或选择下一步来生成随机名字。

string.ID: On the 30th of Kisu Ux, you scuttle down a dark shaft at the edge of a sunken trade path and arrive at a caravanserai. It's powdered in salt and dust from across the ribbon of time.

strings.string: 在基苏·乌克斯月第 30 日，你沿着沉没商路边缘的一条幽暗竖井匆匆下行，抵达一座商队驿站。它覆满来自时间缎带彼端的盐与尘。

string.ID: We're on the surface now. We can walk the whole world this way, or we can access the worldmap to fast travel.

strings.string: 现在我们在地表。我们可以这样步行穿过整个世界，也可以打开世界地图来快速旅行。

string.ID: But first, you just became hungry. You need to eat.

strings.string: 不过首先，你刚刚饿了。你需要吃东西。

string.ID: Let's make camp. How about next to that beetle over there.

strings.string: 扎营吧。就在那边那只甲虫旁边怎么样。

string.ID:
Let's not be rude. Talk to the beetle.
Press =commandKey:CmdUse=.
string.Value:
别失礼。和甲虫说话。
按 =commandKey:CmdUse=。

string.ID:
Let's not be rude. Talk to the beetle.
Press =commandKey:CmdUse= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=.
string.Value:
别失礼。和甲虫说话。
按 =commandKey:CmdUse= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=。

string.ID: Let's not be rude. Talk to the beetle.

Not much of a talker. But that's not true for everyone. As long as a creature isn't hostile, you can try to chat with them.
Let's see what the beetle has for trade.
string.Value:
不太健谈。但不是所有人都这样。只要一个生物没有敌意，你就可以试着和它交谈。
看看这只甲虫有什么可交易的。

string.ID:
The beetle's inventory is on the left, and your inventory is on the right.
The beetle has some witchwood bark. That's useful — it heals you when you eat it. Let's trade for it.
string.Value:
甲虫的物品栏在左边，你的物品栏在右边。
甲虫有一些巫木树皮。那很有用，吃下后能治疗你。把它交易过来吧。

string.ID:
The beetle has some witchwood bark. That's useful — it heals you when you eat it. Let's trade for it.
Press =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=
string.Value:
甲虫有一些巫木树皮。那很有用，吃下后能治疗你。把它交易过来吧。
按 =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=

string.ID:
The beetle has some witchwood bark. That's useful — it heals you when you eat it. Let's trade for it.
Press =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=
string.Value:
甲虫有一些巫木树皮。那很有用，吃下后能治疗你。把它交易过来吧。
按 =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=

string.ID:
We don't need this dagger any more, so we can trade it away.
Press =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=
string.Value:
我们不再需要这把匕首了，可以把它交易出去。
按 =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd=

string.ID:
We don't need this dagger any more, so we can trade it away.
Press =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=
string.Value:
我们不再需要这把匕首了，可以把它交易出去。
按 =commandKey:CmdTradeAdd= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=

string.ID:
The trade is uneven, so we'll have to pony up some money.
In the salt-stippled ecosystem of Qud, {{B|fresh water}} is currency. You need to drink it, too, so don't spend it all.
string.Value:
这笔交易不对等，所以我们得补点钱。
在卡德这片洒满盐粒的生态中，{{B|淡水}}就是货币。你也需要喝水，所以别全花光。

string.ID:
Now to go to the world map. Try ascending again.
Press =commandKey:CmdMoveU=.
string.Value:
现在去世界地图。再试着上楼。
按 =commandKey:CmdMoveU=。

string.ID:
Now to go to the world map. Try ascending again.
You can click this button or press =commandKey:CmdMoveU=.
string.Value:
现在去世界地图。再试着上楼。
你可以点击这个按钮，或按 =commandKey:CmdMoveU=。

string.ID: Before you move on, you should equip yourself from the nearby chest.

strings.string: 继续之前，你应该从附近的箱子里拿些装备。

string.ID:
This is the main gameplay stage. At the top of the screen are your attributes, HP, and XP.
On the right are action buttons, minimap, and the message log.
At the bottom is your ability hotbar.
string.Value:
这是主要游戏界面。屏幕顶部显示你的属性、HP 和 XP。
右侧是行动按钮、小地图和消息日志。
底部是你的能力快捷栏。

string.ID: Let's explore this cave we've found ourselves in.

strings.string: 探索一下我们所在的这座洞穴吧。

string.ID:
Huh, you destroyed the tutorial chest we were going to teach you how to use.
Go ahead and pick of the torch and dagger from the floor.
string.Value:
咦，你把我们原本要用来教学的教程箱子毁掉了。
那就直接从地上捡起火把和匕首吧。

string.ID: A torch. When it's nighttime or when you're underground, you need a torch equipped to see. Select it.

strings.string: 一支火把。夜晚或地下时，你需要装备火把才能看清。选中它。

string.ID:
You can interact with objects you're next to. Open the chest.
Press =commandKey:Accept=
string.Value:
你可以和身旁的物体互动。打开箱子。
按 =commandKey:Accept=

string.ID:
You can interact with objects you're next to. Open the chest.
Press =commandKey:Accept= or =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=
string.Value:
你可以和身旁的物体互动。打开箱子。
按 =commandKey:Accept= 或 =commandKey:AdventureMouseContextAction=

string.ID:
Looks like there's a chest over at the end of the room. Let's walk over to it.
Hold =commandKey:IndicateDirection= in the direction you want to move and press =commandKey:Take A Step=.
string.Value:
房间尽头好像有个箱子。走过去吧。
按住 =commandKey:IndicateDirection= 指向你想移动的方向，再按 =commandKey:Take A Step=。

房间尽头好像有个箱子。走过去吧。
你可以用 =commandKey:AdventureNavMouseLeftClick= 点击想移动到的格子，或使用 {{hotkey|arrow keys}}、{{hotkey|numpad.}}。
使用方向键时，可以按 {{hotkey|shift+arrow keys}} 斜向移动。

string.ID: We're not quite ready to leave yet.

string.ID: In %=year=%, Rebekah died of glotrot, and on her deathbed Resheph forgave her and absolved her of sin. He allowed her to be buried in the village of Ezra, outside the gate to the Tomb of the Eaters and beneath the shadow of the Spindle.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，丽贝卡死于舌腐病。临终之际，瑞谢夫宽恕了她，赦免了她的罪。他允许她葬在以斯拉村，葬在食客之墓门外、尖塔阴影之下。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Resheph appointed Rebekah administrator of =region=. She tendered alms for the sick in his name.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，瑞谢夫任命丽贝卡为 =region= 的行政官。她以他的名义向病者施舍救济。

string.ID: Acting against a prohibition on the practice of worshipping the stars, Resheph led an army to the gates of Omonporch. There he defeated his brothers in battle and liberated its citizens, and they crowned him the sultan of Qud.

strings.string: 为反抗对崇拜星辰之习俗的禁令，瑞谢夫率军来到奥蒙廊的城门。在那里，他于战斗中击败自己的兄弟，解放了城中市民；他们将他加冕为圣地库德的帝王。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Rebekah betrayed Resheph by stealing the Mark of Death from the gate to the Tomb of the Eaters. In punishment, Resheph excommunicated her from the sultanate.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，丽贝卡从食客之墓门口偷走死亡印记，背叛了瑞谢夫。作为惩罚，瑞谢夫将她逐出了帝国。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Resheph cleansed the marshlands of the plagues of the Gyre and taught Abram to sow watervine along its fertile tracks.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，瑞谢夫净除了沼泽地里的轮回瘟疫，并教亚伯兰在其肥沃的泥径旁播种水藤。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Resheph closed the gates to the Tomb of the Eaters, abdicated the throne, and dissolved the sultanate in order to lift the curse of the Gyre.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，瑞谢夫关闭了食客之墓的大门，退位离开王座，并解散帝国，以解除轮回的诅咒。

string.ID: In %=year=%, Resheph, the Above, Ghost-in-Cerulean, the Coiled Lamb of Baetyls, died of natural causes. He was 216 years old.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，瑞谢夫，至上者，天青幽灵，贝泰尔的盘卷羔羊，自然死亡。他享年 216 岁。

string.ID: After conferring with mysterious strangers, Resheph convinced them to help him found a harborage for the purpose of receiving visitors from across the clustered cosmos. They named it Starfarer's Quay.

strings.string: 在与神秘陌生人商议后，瑞谢夫说服他们帮助自己创立一处避泊港，用来接待来自群簇宇宙各处的访客。他们将其命名为星旅者码头。

string.ID: While traveling alone through the Rust Wells, Resheph came across a trove of gleaming stars in a bottle. From that day forth, he always kept some stardust on his person.

strings.string: 独自穿过锈井旅行时，瑞谢夫遇见了一瓶闪耀群星。从那天起，他总在身上藏着一些星尘。

string.ID: In %=year=%, the Gyre widened, and the first triad of plagues afflicted the land. The water was poisoned with salt, girshlings ravaged the fruit and wheat, and tongues rotted away in the mouths of kith and kin. Resheph walked below the chrome arches and healed the sick.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，轮回扩大，第一组三重瘟疫降临大地。水被盐毒污染，吉尔什幼体蹂躏果实与麦田，亲族同胞口中的舌头腐烂脱落。瑞谢夫行走在铬拱之下，治愈病者。

string.ID: In %=year=%, the Gyre widened, and the second triad of plagues afflicted the land. The legs of kith and kin annealed to iron, darkness bloomed from the earth, and the svardym blackened the sky. Resheph walked below the chrome arches and healed the sick.

strings.string: 在 %=year=% 年，轮回扩大，第二组三重瘟疫降临大地。亲族同胞的双腿退火成铁，黑暗自大地绽放，斯瓦尔德姆遮黑了天空。瑞谢夫行走在铬拱之下，治愈病者。

string.ID: One starry evening, a babe was found swaddled with its mouth full of circuits by a group of baetyls in Red Rock. They took him into their fold and fostered him, and he became known as Resheph, the Coiled Lamb of Baetyls.

strings.string: 一个繁星满天的夜晚，一群贝泰尔在红岩发现了一个裹在襁褓中的婴孩，口中塞满电路。他们将他纳入同群并抚养成人，他从此以瑞谢夫，贝泰尔的盘卷羔羊，闻名。

string.ID: At Starfarer's Quay, Resheph consulted with mysterious strangers and learned the secret of the Gyre. By cause of the misdeeds of the elder saads and sultans, star beings had levied a curse on Qud. Resheph vowed to make right from this wrong and redeem our doomed world.

strings.string: 在星旅者码头，瑞谢夫向神秘陌生人求教，得知了轮回的秘密。由于古老萨阿德与帝王们的恶行，星辰存在向库德降下了诅咒。瑞谢夫誓要纠正这桩错误，拯救我们注定毁灭的世界。

string.ID: While traveling near Bethesda Susa, Resheph lost control of his chariot and drove it off a cliff. Luckily, a local physician named Rebekah came to his rescue. Moved by her kindness, Resheph enrolled at a nearby hospice as her apprentice.

strings.string: 在贝塞斯达苏萨附近旅行时，瑞谢夫的战车失控冲下悬崖。幸运的是，一位名叫丽贝卡的当地医师前来救助他。瑞谢夫为她的善意所动，在附近一所济养院登记为她的学徒。

string.ID: In %=year=%, the Gyre widened, and the final plague afflicted the land. The Girsh Nephilim rose from their cradles on the Moon Stair and slouched toward Qud to eat its young. Resheph rose to meet them in battle and cast them back.

strings.string: 在 %=year% 年，轮回扩大，最终瘟疫降临大地。吉尔什拿非利从月阶上的摇篮中升起，佝偻着走向库德，欲吞食其幼子。瑞谢夫挺身迎战，将他们击退。

string.ID: At twilight in the shadow of the Spindle, the people of Omonporch saw an image on the horizon that looked like a ghost bathed in cerulean. It was Resheph, and after he came and left Omonporch, the people built a monument to him, and thenceforth called him Ghost-in-Cerulean.

strings.string: 黄昏时，在尖塔的阴影中，奥蒙廊的人民看见地平线上有一道影像，像是沐浴在天青色中的幽灵。那正是瑞谢夫；他来到奥蒙廊又离去后，人民为他建起纪念碑，并从此称他为天青幽灵。

string.ID: You cannot do that from here.
The shomer Rainwater claims that Brightsheol is the dream of a seraph who lives atop the Spindle.

strings.string: 守望者雨水声称，光明阴府是居于尖塔顶端的一位炽天使的梦。

string.ID: In the mystic air of Jeweled Dusk, a circle of farmers clasped hands and sheathed a vinereaper in the moistened soil. From then on, the villagers of Joppa were known as the people of the vine.

strings.string: 在宝石暮色的神秘空气中，一圈农民手牵着手，将一把藤收割镰插入湿润土壤。自那以后，约帕村民便以藤蔓之民闻名。

string.ID: Since the first festival of Ut yara Ux, the villagers of Joppa have feasted on warm apple matz.

strings.string: 自第一届乌特雅拉乌克斯节以来，约帕村民便一直享用温热苹果马茨的盛宴。

string.ID: Under the Beetle Moon, folks settled here to gather goods of passage for Ape Saad Oboroqoru, and so Kyakukya was founded.

strings.string: 甲虫月下，人们在此定居，为猿萨阿德奥博罗阔鲁收集通行之物，于是喀库喀建立了。

string.ID: In 979, Nuntu, the legendary albino ape, grew tired of bludgeoning things to death and journeyed to a root-strangled place on the River Svy. There he came upon Kyakukya and its inhabitants. The villagers of Kyakukya asked Nuntu to employ his magisterial skills and lead the village.

strings.string: 979 年，传奇白化猿努恩图厌倦了把东西锤打至死，前往斯维河上一处根须缠结之地。在那里，他遇见了喀库喀及其居民。喀库喀的村民请求努恩图施展他的威严技艺，领导村庄。

string.ID: Centuries after the height of the Gyre, the svardym Goek, Mak, and Geeub met the galgal Many Eyes while languishing inside of a reef sponge. Together they founded the Yd Freehold to live out the rest of their lives.

strings.string: 轮回鼎盛数个世纪后，斯瓦尔德姆戈埃克、马克和吉乌布在礁海绵中受困衰弱时，遇见了迦勒迦勒“众眼”。他们共同建立了伊德自由领，以度过余生。

string.ID: In 901, the villagers of the Yd Freehold and its founders abolished all forms of hierarchy from their settlement. The two pillars of civic life in the Freehold thus became anarchy and authenticity.

strings.string: 901 年，伊德自由领的村民及其创建者废除了聚落中的一切等级制度。自由领公民生活的两大支柱由此变成无政府与真实。

string.ID: =spice:quests.thanks.!random|capitalize=. Our village owes you a debt. For now, please choose a reward from our stockpile as payment for your service.

strings.string: =spice:quests.thanks.!random|capitalize=。我们的村庄欠你一份人情。现在，请从我们的储备中选择一件奖励，作为你服务的报酬。

string.Context: DynamicQuestConversationHelper village zero main quest dialog
string.ID: They are disciples of Barathrum. Mostly they are Urshiib, like their mentor. Mutant albino cave bears. With quills to boot! A thousand years ago Barathrum and his kin crossed the Homs Delta into the heart of Qud. He has spent centuries fiddling with the tokens of antiquity in his underground workshops.

strings.string: 他们是巴拉瑟姆的门徒。大多数都是乌尔希布，和他们的导师一样。突变的白化洞熊，而且还长着刺！一千年前，巴拉瑟姆和他的族人越过霍姆斯三角洲，进入库德腹地。此后数百年里，他一直在地下工坊中摆弄古代遗物。

string.Context: DynamicQuestConversationHelper village zero main quest choice
string.ID: I will take the disk to Grit Gate and speak with the Barathrumites.

strings.string: 我会把磁盘带到砂砾门，与巴拉瑟姆派交谈。

string.Context: DynamicQuestConversationHelper village zero main quest choice deny
string.ID: I must pass on this offer, for now. Live and drink.

strings.string: 这份提议我暂且谢绝。生而饮水。

string.Context: DynamicQuestConversationHelper village zero main quest restart dialog
string.ID:
Are you seeking more work, =player.formalAddressTerm=? Recently we came into possession of a data disk bearing a peculiar stamp and encoded with a strange signal. The signal means nothing to us, but there's a sect of tinkers called the Barathrumites who might be interested in it. They are friends to our village and often trade for the scrap we tow out of the earth. Would you carry the disk to their enclave at Grit Gate, along the western rim of the jungle? In exchange for the delivery, you might seek an apprenticeship with them.
If you are interested, take the disk now, and travel safely.
string.Value:
你在寻找更多工作吗，=player.formalAddressTerm=？最近我们得到了一张数据磁盘，上面带有奇特印记，还编码着一种古怪信号。我们不明白这信号的含义，但有个名叫巴拉瑟姆派的修补匠宗派也许会对此感兴趣。他们是我们村庄的朋友，经常拿我们从地里拖出来的废料做交易。你愿意把这张磁盘带到他们位于砂砾门的飞地吗？那里在丛林西缘。作为递送的交换，你也许可以向他们寻求学徒身份。
如果你有兴趣，现在就拿上磁盘，一路平安。

strings.string: 这些巴拉瑟姆派是什么人？

string.ID:
Oh, you died. That's okay. It's a very common occurance in the world of Qud.
Because the tutorial drops you off in Classic mode with permadeath, your character is wiped when you die.
The good news is: you get to make a whole new character! Now with a little more knowledge than you had before.
string.Value:
噢，你死了。没关系。这在科德世界里非常常见。
因为教程会把你放进带有永久死亡的经典模式，所以你的角色会在死亡时被清除。
好消息是：你可以创建一个全新的角色！而且现在比之前多了一点知识。

string.ID:
Next time, if you want a more forgiving mode of play, try Roleplay, which lets you checkpoint at settlements.
Or try Wander mode, where most creatures are neutral to you and you gain experience via discovery instead of killing.
Or keep playing Classic if the challenge appeals to you and you'd like to explore a breadth of character types.
string.Value:
下次，如果你想要更宽容的游玩模式，可以试试角色扮演模式，它允许你在聚落设置检查点。
或者试试漫游模式，其中大多数生物都会对你保持中立，你通过发现而不是杀戮获得经验。
如果挑战正合你意，并且你想探索各种角色类型，也可以继续玩经典模式。

string.ID:
On the =day= of =month=, you arrive at the oasis-hamlet of {{green|Joppa}}, along the far rim of {{Y|Moghra'yi, the Great Salt Desert}}.
All around you, moisture farmers tend to groves of viridian watervine. There are huts wrought from rock salt and brinestalk.
On the horizon, {{r|Qud's}} jungles strangle chrome steeples and rusted archways to the earth. Further and beyond, the fabled {{C|Spindle}} rises above the fray and pierces the cloud-ribboned sky.
string.Value:
=month= 的第 =day= 日，你来到绿洲小村 {{green|约帕}}，它坐落在 {{Y|莫格拉伊，大盐漠}} 的遥远边缘。
你周围，湿气农夫照料着翠绿的水藤林。岩盐和盐茎筑成的小屋散落其间。
地平线上，{{r|科德}} 的丛林将铬质尖塔和锈蚀拱门缠缚回大地。更远处，传说中的 {{C|尖塔}} 高出纷争，刺入云带缠绕的天空。

string.ID: The chuppah of Qas and Qon
I found a bloody patch of fur near the village paths, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 我在村中小径附近发现一片带血的毛皮，这是近期发生暴力事件的迹象。

string.ID: Is that a patch of hindren fur? There's blood on it...
string.Value: 那是一片欣德伦毛皮吗？上面有血……

string.ID: I discovered a patch of watervine stained red with blood, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 我发现一片被血染红的水藤，这是近期发生暴力事件的迹象。

string.ID: How odd, this watervine is stained red with blood.
string.Value: 真奇怪，这株水藤被血染红了。

string.ID: I found a weapon haft, broken from use, on the paths, a sign of recent violence.

strings.string: 我在小径上发现一截因使用而断裂的武器柄，这是近期发生暴力事件的迹象。

string.ID: How odd, the broken haft of a weapon, a sign of recent violence.
string.Value: 真奇怪，一截断裂的武器柄，这是近期发生暴力事件的迹象。

string.ID: Someone left a sealed merchant's waterskin on the paths, a sign of recent trade.

strings.string: 有人把一个密封的商人水囊留在小径上，这是近期发生贸易的迹象。

string.ID: Hmm, this waterskin is still sealed with wax.
string.Value: 嗯，这只水囊仍用蜡封着。

string.ID: Someone dropped a copper nugget on the paths, a sign of recent trade.

strings.string: 有人在小径上掉了一块铜粒，这是近期发生贸易的迹象。

string.ID: How odd, there's a copper nugget just lying on the ground.
string.Value: 真奇怪，地上就这么躺着一块铜粒。

string.ID: I discovered a footprint from a great saltback on the paths, a sign of recent trade.

strings.string: 我在小径上发现一个巨盐背留下的脚印，这是近期发生贸易的迹象。

string.Value: 这脚印可真大。

string.ID: I found a detached tongue on the ground, rotted with infection: a sign of recent illness.

strings.string: 我在地上发现一条脱落的舌头，已因感染而腐烂：这是近期发生疾病的迹象。

string.ID: Oh gross, there's a rotten tongue on the ground!
string.Value: 呕，地上有条烂舌头！

string.ID: I found the discarded husks of the curative yuckwheat plant, a sign of recent illness.

strings.string: 我发现了被丢弃的药用恶心麦外壳，这是近期发生疾病的迹象。

string.ID: How odd, some discarded chaff from a yuckwheat plant.
string.Value: 真奇怪，一些被丢弃的恶心麦糠。

string.ID: I found a few scraps from some kind of leatherworking project, a sign of recent craft.

strings.string: 我发现几片某种皮革活计留下的碎料，这是近期进行工艺制作的迹象。

string.ID: How odd, someone dropped some scraps of cut leather here.
string.Value: 真奇怪，有人在这里掉了几片裁下的皮革。

string.ID: Someone discarded a worn but still functional leather bracer on the paths, a sign of recent craft.

strings.string: 有人在小径上丢弃了一只磨损但仍能用的皮护腕，这是近期进行工艺制作的迹象。

string.ID: This leather bracer has seen some use. Why is it out here?
string.Value: 这只皮护腕用过不少次了。为什么会在这里？

string.ID: I found a small leatherworking hammer on the paths, a sign of recent craft.

strings.string: 我在小径上发现一把小皮革锤，这是近期进行工艺制作的迹象。

string.ID: Someone has left a small hammer on the path.
string.Value: 有人把一把小锤子留在了路上。

string.ID: One villager was frightened by sounds of fighting at night, indicating recent violence.

strings.string: 一名村民被夜间的打斗声吓坏了，这表明近期发生过暴力事件。

string.ID: I heard the sounds of fighting the other night! I stayed in the next day, so afeared was I.

strings.string: 前几晚我听见了打斗声！我吓得第二天都没出门。

string.ID: One of Bey Lah's scouts heard a fight in the watervine paddies, indicating recent violence.

strings.string: 贝拉的一名斥候听见水藤田里有打斗声，这表明近期发生过暴力事件。

string.ID: I thought I heard splashing from a fight in the marsh grids, but I couldn't find anyone.

strings.string: 我好像听见沼田格里传来打斗溅水声，但我没找到任何人。

string.ID: Faundren saw a merchant from outside the village sneaking around, indicating recent trade.

strings.string: 幼欣德伦看见一名村外商人鬼鬼祟祟地徘徊，这表明近期发生过贸易。

string.ID: I saw a kendren merchant the other day! They were being very sneaky, so I think they were meeting someone in secret! Isn't that interesting?

strings.string: 前几天我看见一名肯德伦商人！他们鬼鬼祟祟的，所以我觉得他们是在偷偷见什么人！这不是很有意思吗？

string.ID: The faundren heard the voice of a hindren and a kendren discussing goods late at night, indicating recent trade.

strings.string: 幼欣德伦深夜听见一名欣德伦和一名肯德伦讨论货物，这表明近期发生过贸易。

string.ID: I heard a hindren talking about buying and selling to a kendren late at night! I thought that all kendren had to report to Grand-Doe?

strings.string: 我深夜听见一名欣德伦跟一名肯德伦谈买卖！我以为所有肯德伦都必须向大母鹿报备？

string.ID: The villagers are on edge due to rumors of sore throats in the village, indicating recent illness.

strings.string: 村民们因村中喉咙痛的传闻而紧张不安，这表明近期发生过疾病。

string.ID: I heard that someone in the village might have a sore throat, so I am staying at least ten handspan away from everyone today.

strings.string: 我听说村里可能有人喉咙痛，所以今天我要跟所有人至少保持十掌距。

string.ID: The faundren are complaining about the smell of yuckwheat tea, indicating recent illness.

strings.string: 幼欣德伦在抱怨恶心麦茶的气味，这表明近期发生过疾病。

string.ID: I smelled yuckwheat tea the other day! That smell is so terrible! Is someone sick?

strings.string: 前几天我闻到了恶心麦茶！那味道太糟了！有人病了吗？

string.ID: The scouts report that someone has taken leather from the village stores, indicating recent craft.

strings.string: 斥候报告有人从村中库房取走了皮革，这表明近期进行过工艺制作。

string.ID: I went to do some repairs to my boots, but someone's been in our stores of boar leather! We have far less than we should.

strings.string: 我本来想去修修靴子，可有人动过我们库房里的野猪皮！剩下的比应有的少多了。

string.ID: The scouts heard someone doing work with tools late at night, indicating recent craft.

strings.string: 斥候听见有人深夜使用工具干活，这表明近期进行过工艺制作。

string.ID: I heard someone doing some kind of toolwork during a night watch shift. I didn't interrupt, but it seemed peculiar.

strings.string: 我在值夜时听见有人在做某种工具活。我没有打断，但那事显得很古怪。

string.ID: I found an empty injector near the Hindriarch's bedroll. Why doesn't anyone know she was sick?

strings.string: 我在欣德族女族长的铺盖附近发现一支空注射器。为什么没人知道她病了？

string.ID: Hmm. This injector has been used.
string.Value: 嗯。这支注射器已经用过了。

string.ID: I found a bloody arrow on the paths of Bey Lah. Its fletching resembles the ones in Hindriarch Keh's quiver.

strings.string: 我在贝拉的小径上发现一支带血的箭。它的箭羽很像欣德族女族长凯箭囊里的那些。

string.ID: Why, this arrow is covered with blood!
string.Value: 哎呀，这支箭上满是血！

string.ID: Apparently, the Hindriarch isolated herself to work on a mystery project, possibly to hide Kindrish.

strings.string: 显然，欣德族女族长把自己隔离起来做某个神秘项目，可能是为了藏匿金德里什。

string.ID: You know, Grand-Doe spent some late nights working on something she wouldn't talk about. I wonder what that was.

strings.string: 你知道吗，大母鹿有几晚熬到很晚，在做什么她不愿谈起的东西。我真想知道那是什么。

string.ID: Rumor has it that the village is flush with water, perhaps because Keh made a big trade.

strings.string: 传闻说村里水很充裕，也许是因为凯做了一笔大交易。

string.ID: By the Eaters, how prosperous we've been. I've never seen the village so flush with fresh water.

strings.string: 食客在上，我们最近可真富足。我从没见过村里有这么多淡水。

string.ID: The faundren claim that Eskhind left the village sporting a poorly-made leather bracer, possibly to conceal Kindrish.

strings.string: 幼欣德伦声称埃斯欣德离村时戴着一只做工拙劣的皮护腕，可能是为了藏起金德里什。

string.ID: Just before auntie Eskhind left the village, I saw her wearing a new bracer. It looked terrible!

strings.string: 埃斯欣德阿姨刚离开村子前，我看见她戴着一只新护腕。看起来糟透了！

string.ID: The faundren tell me that Eskhind's sister had a period of complete silence; she may have been ill.

strings.string: 幼欣德伦告诉我，埃斯欣德的妹妹有一段时间完全沉默；她可能病了。

string.ID: You know auntie Eskhind's little sister, Liihart? She's always been quiet, but she didn't talk at all for, uh, two whole weeks before they left!

strings.string: 你知道埃斯欣德阿姨的小妹妹利哈特吗？她一直很安静，可她们离开前，呃，整整两个星期她一句话都没说！

string.ID: I found the village stores of Bey Lah untouched; Eskhind must have traded something for her basics.

strings.string: 我发现贝拉的村中库房无人动过；埃斯欣德一定是用某样东西换来了基本用品。

string.ID: Whoever stole Kindrish didn't steal from the village stores. These chests are simply packed with dried lah, vinewafers, and waterskins.

strings.string: 偷走金德里什的人并没有偷村中库房。这些箱子里满满都是干拉、藤饼和水囊。

string.ID: Eskhind is showing signs of a leg injury. Perhaps she was in a fight.
string.Value: 埃斯欣德显出腿伤的迹象。也许她卷入过打斗。

string.ID: Eskhind appears to be favoring a leg, though she has concealed any injury.
string.Value: 埃斯欣德似乎偏护着一条腿，尽管她掩盖了任何伤势。

strings.string: 埃斯欣德正偏护着一条腿。

string.ID: The faundren tell me that Kesehind went quiet for a few weeks, only to become louder than ever again.

strings.string: 幼欣德伦告诉我，凯瑟欣德沉默了几个星期，之后却变得比以往更吵。

string.ID: For weeks and weeks, Kesehind was so quiet, but now he's talking more than ever! He's so loud!

strings.string: 好几个星期里，凯瑟欣德都特别安静，可现在他说得比以前还多！他太吵了！

string.ID: Rumor has it that Kesehind has always worn hand-me-down armor, but he was recently seen with a brand new set.

strings.string: 传闻说凯瑟欣德一直穿旧护甲，但最近有人看见他穿着一套全新的。

string.ID: Did you see Kesehind's armor? He always used to wear hand-me-downs from the scouts, but what he's wearing now looks brand new!

strings.string: 你看见凯瑟欣德的护甲了吗？他以前总穿斥候们传下来的旧货，可他现在穿的看起来崭新！

string.ID: I found a worn-out bracer abandoned near Kesehind's bedroll.

strings.string: 我在凯瑟欣德的铺盖附近发现一只被丢弃的破旧护腕。

string.ID: That's strange. This bracer is heavily worn, but surprisingly clean.
string.Value: 真奇怪。这只护腕磨损很重，却出奇地干净。

string.ID: Kesehind tried to clean blood off his armor, but missed a spot.
string.Value: 凯瑟欣德试图擦掉护甲上的血，但漏了一处。

string.ID: Carmine streaks on Kesehind's armor suggest that he tried and failed to wipe away spilled blood.
string.Value: 凯瑟欣德护甲上的深红条痕表明，他试过擦去溅上的血，却没能擦干净。

string.ID: Kesehind's armor has bloodstains that he failed to remove.
string.Value: 凯瑟欣德的护甲上有他没能清除的血迹。

string.ID: The Bey Lah scouts have had trouble with violent kendren. What if one slipped by?

strings.string: 贝拉斥候一直受暴力肯德伦困扰。如果有一个溜过去了呢？

string.ID: The kendren are becoming more brazen in their hostility. I've had to misdirect and fight them off several times this month alone.

strings.string: 肯德伦的敌意越来越明目张胆。光这个月，我就不得不误导并击退他们好几次。

string.ID: The scouts have seen kendren treasure hunters about. That type will take anything not nailed down.

strings.string: 斥候们见过肯德伦寻宝者出没。那种人什么没钉牢就拿什么。

string.ID: I came across some kendren who claimed to be treasure hunters. They said that they would pay good water for unique artifacts or treasures.

strings.string: 我遇到过一些自称寻宝者的肯德伦。他们说愿意为独特的遗物或宝藏付一大笔水。

string.ID: Theft by kendren is very common during an outbreak of disease like the one the villagers describe.

strings.string: 在村民描述的这种疾病爆发期间，肯德伦盗窃很常见。

string.ID: I've heard that there is an outbreak of glotrot in the kendren villages outside of Bey Lah. Now I want to leave here even less!

strings.string: 我听说贝拉外面的肯德伦村庄爆发了舌腐病。现在我更不想离开这里了！

string.ID: I found a set of foreign leatherworking tools on the village paths. A kendren crafter has been here.

strings.string: 我在村中小径上发现一套外来的皮革工具。有肯德伦工匠来过这里。

string.ID: This set of leatherworking tools is shockingly well-made.
string.Value: 这套皮革工具做工好得惊人。
